description: This Java source file defines a REST controller class `DummyApiController` for handling HTTP POST requests to endpoints `/test/dummy/sync` and `/test/dummy/async`. It processes `DummyRequest` objects, invokes a command pipeline, and returns `DummyResponse` objects, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: DummyApiController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides endpoints for processing dummy commands synchronously and asynchronously, managing tenant context, and invoking a command pipeline.

methods.name: dummySync
methods.description: Handles synchronous HTTP POST requests for `/test/dummy/sync`, constructs a DummyCommand, sets tenant context, sends the command through the pipeline, and returns a DummyResponse.

methods.name: dummyAsync
methods.description: Handles asynchronous HTTP POST requests for `/test/dummy/async`, constructs a DummyCommand, sets tenant context, and returns a CompletableFuture that supplies the DummyResponse asynchronously.
